Loupe's tag. A small coloured label for a category or a tone.

```jsx
<Tag tone="neutral">Example</Tag>
<Tag tone="lime">Example</Tag>
<Tag tone="purple">Example</Tag>
<Tag tone="green">Example</Tag>
<Tag tone="amber">Example</Tag>
<Tag tone="red">Example</Tag>
<Tag tone="teal">Example</Tag>
<Tag tone="sky">Example</Tag>
<Tag tone="blue">Example</Tag>
<Tag tone="indigo">Example</Tag>
<Tag tone="pink">Example</Tag>
<Tag tone="orange">Example</Tag>
```

Variants: `neutral`, `lime`, `purple`, `green`, `amber`, `red`, `teal`, `sky`, `blue`, `indigo`, `pink`, `orange`.

Labels are sentence case and never end in a full stop. The component emits the real `lp-tag` classes of the app.
